preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: the first line is the string S, and the second line is the integer k.
The first line (string S) contains only alphabetic characters.
The integer k is positive and does not exceed the length of S.
The length of S is a multiple of k (guaranteed by problem constraints).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join([''.join([c for i, c in enumerate(t) if c not in t[:i]]).strip() for t in [stdin.splitlines()[0][i:i+k] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()[0]), k)]]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each substring t_i of length k in S (split into contiguous blocks of size k), the output line u_i is the subsequence of t_i where each character appears exactly once in the order of their first occurrence in t_i. The output consists of exactly n/k lines, one for each u_i.
